description: This file defines the implementation of a FetchArtifactsAction within the orchestrator package. It handles the process of validating requests, managing artifact downloads, and coordinating operations related to fetching artifacts such as CVDBundles, kernels, and bootloaders in an Android Cuttlefish environment.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsActionOpts
classes.description: Struct containing options for creating a FetchArtifactsAction, including request details, paths, operation manager, and artifact fetchers.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsAction
classes.description: Main class handling the fetch artifacts operation, including validation, download initiation, and asynchronous execution.

methods.name: NewFetchArtifactsAction
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new FetchArtifactsAction instance based on provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the fetch artifacts process, validating requests, preparing directories, and managing asynchronous download work.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Internal method to start downloading the required artifacts based on the request; handles different bundle types.
